# InstaSaver

> Free online tool to download Instagram videos, reels, photos, and audio (MP3) in original quality. No sign-in required.

## What It Does

- [Download Instagram videos and reels as MP4 in original quality](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Extract Instagram reel audio and save as MP3](https://igreelssave.com/audio)
- [Download Instagram photos and carousels in full resolution JPG](https://igreelssave.com/photo)
- [Supports public posts, reels, carousels, and feed videos](https://igreelssave.com/)

## How It Works

- [Copy the Instagram post/reel URL](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Paste it on the site](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Download the media file directly](https://igreelssave.com/)

## Key Features

- [No account or login required](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Original quality files from Instagram CDN](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Free with no download limits](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [Supports carousels (multiple slides)](https://igreelssave.com/)
- [No files stored on servers](https://igreelssave.com/)
